statement: PJM runs the grid in 13 states and the District of Columbia
The 2026/27, 2027/28, and 2028/29 Base Residual Auctions cleared at the price cap
Without the price cap, the 2028/29 auction would have cleared at $554.72 per MW-day
PJM's 2027/28 auction cleared about 6,520 MW below its reliability requirement (about 210 MW short in 2026/27)
source: Monitoring Analytics (PJM Independent Market Monitor), 2025 State of the Market Report for PJM, March 2026
